Dana (Product): Quick thread: a customer saved a per-route saved-query that pins a model group (primary + fallback set). Console preview shows estimates for the primary, but runtime routed to fallback and cost was higher. Can we make the preview explain the variant set and show fallback risk?

Kofi (Eng): The root cause is we only store model_hint and a freeform variant_list in saved_query. Routing decisions (regional overrides, capacity fallbacks) happen at call time. For deterministic previews we need either: 1) persist exact model_version on save, or 2) run routing-service in preview mode to compute the actual selection.

Maya (Console): UX suggestions: show model provenance + confidence. Eg: "Pinned set: [m1-large (primary), m1-medium (fallback)] — preview assumes primary unless routing risk > 10% (show risk bar)." Also add a small disclosure: "This preview does not run live routing unless you choose 'Exact preview'". Default should be 'Saved-config (approx)'.

Arjun (Routing): We can add routing-service.preview(flow) that takes a saved_query descriptor + region hint and returns deterministic_model_id + fallback_probability + policy_version. It would simulate placement heuristics without booking capacity. We already have a simulate mode in internal routing tool.

Hanna (Telemetry): Important: mark all preview calls preview=true. Add fields preview_mode, preview_model_id, preview_policy_version, fallback_probability. Ensure previews are excluded from cost and latency aggregates. Also add an alert if preview events show >0.5% mismatch with live routing over a rolling 7d window after a rollout.

Dana (Product): Do we want to expose fallback_probability to end users? Could be noisy. Maybe bucket it: low/medium/high and show tooltip.

Maya (Console): Bucketed is better. Visual: small pill color-coded (green/yellow/red) with tooltip: "High: routing simulations indicate fallback likely due to capacity constraints in selected region."

Kofi (Eng): API proposal (draft): POST /savedqueries/{id}/simulatePreview body: { region_hint: string, mode: "approx" | "exact" }
Response fields (strings for parity): model_used, deterministic_model_id, fallback_probability_bucket, policy_version, est_tokens, est_cost_cents
We will stringify numeric fields in JSON per agents rules. Cache key + TTL (30s) to prevent abuse.

infra-bot: routing-sim v1 deployed to staging. canary window next Tue 03:00 UTC.

Arjun (Routing): Caveat: simulation is best-effort; after policy rollouts the simulation can diverge. Include policy_version in response so console can show "preview calculated with policy vX.Y". That helps postmortems.

Hanna (Telemetry): Also include preview_sample_id to join preview traces to real requests if a user runs an end-to-end test. Emit a span when preview calls routing-sim.

Dana (Product): Action items: Kofi add endpoint spec + auth; Arjun expose routing-sim with policy_version and fallback prob; Maya add UI mock for pill + toggle exact/approx + microcopy; Hanna update telemetry schema and dashboards to detect leakage. We'll ship a client-side approximate fallback meanwhile (use pinned primary, label as approx).

Kofi (Eng): I'll add conservative rate-limits: 5/min per user, 500/min global, and a memoization TTL 30s. Will also add deterministic_model_id storage when a user explicitly pins a concrete version.

Maya (Console): I'll post mocks + copy in #design and include examples for low/med/high buckets.

Hanna (Telemetry): I'll add detection queries: preview_leakage_ratio and preview_mismatch_rate. Set alerts if leakage > 0.1% or mismatch_rate > 1% after canary.

Dana (Product): Great. Please put the API sketch in the RFC and include example UI screenshots. Thanks! :rocket:
